select item_id, run_id, key_id, user_id, user_name, key_name, encryt_name, key_version, verdict, rule, summary, create_time from key_health_scan_item
mapper.insert: insert into key_health_scan_run ( run_id, user_id, scope, started_at, finished_at, total, ok_count, warn_count, error_count, note, create_time ) values ( #{runId}, #{userId}, #{scope}, #{startedAt}, null, 0, 0, 0, 0, null, now() )
mapper.update: update key_health_scan_run set finished_at = #{finishedAt}, total = #{total}, ok_count = #{okCount}, warn_count = #{warnCount}, error_count = #{errorCount}, note = #{note} where run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert:
insert into key_health_scan_item ( run_id, key_id, user_id, user_name, key_name, encryt_name, key_version, verdict, rule, summary, create_time ) values
( #{item.runId}, #{item.keyId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.userName}, #{item.keyName}, #{item.encrytName}, #{item.keyVersion}, #{item.verdict}, #{item.rule}, #{item.summary}, now() )
mapper.select:
select r.run_id, r.user_id, r.scope, r.started_at, r.finished_at,
(select count(*) from key_health_scan_item i where i.run_id = r.run_id and i.user_id = #{userId}) as total, (select count(*) from key_health_scan_item i where i.run_id = r.run_id and i.user_id = #{userId} and i.verdict = 'OK') as ok_count, (select count(*) from key_health_scan_item i where i.run_id = r.run_id and i.user_id = #{userId} and i.verdict = 'WARN') as warn_count, (select count(*) from key_health_scan_item i where i.run_id = r.run_id and i.user_id = #{userId} and i.verdict = 'ERROR') as error_count,
r.total, r.ok_count, r.warn_count, r.error_count,
r.note, r.create_time from key_health_scan_run r
and r.run_id = #{runId} and r.scope = #{scope}
and ( r.user_id = #{userId} or exists ( select 1 from key_health_scan_item i where i.run_id = r.run_id and i.user_id = #{userId} ) )
order by r.started_at desc, r.run_id desc
